acceptance_criteria.statement: Implement immutable unified cost and quota ledger has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Repository traceability, upstream-adoption truth, budget migrations, evidence, and external truth boundaries remain consistent.

definition_of_done: Implementation is present and locally behaviorally verified.
Unknown price and unknown outcomes never become zero/free or blind retries.
Unavailable external budget integrations remain explicitly unverified.
description: Implement immutable unified cost and quota ledger. This Pass 14 task implements and locally verifies the bounded Budget Governor scope while preserving truthful external billing, Infracost, and AWS qualification state.
exclusions: No live provider-billing reconciliation is claimed.
No live AWS budget/alarm circuit breaker is claimed.
objective: Implement immutable unified cost and quota ledger
observability_impact: Cost, quota, reservations, forecasts, anomalies, and outcome efficiency are structured and queryable.
rationale: Budget authority must remain deterministic, concurrency-safe, evidence-backed, and conservative when price or remote outcome is unknown.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve immutable ledger and reconciliation records; rollback code/configuration without rewriting historical cost truth.
security_impact: Budget admission uses bounded authority, atomic leases, protected reserve, and conservative unknown-cost semantics.
title: Implement immutable unified cost and quota ledger
